name: print_string_with_suffix
desc: Prints a '$'-terminated string passed via DS:DX, followed by a fixed suffix string at DS:[01B9h].
details: Calls DOS INT 21h function 09h to output the '$'-terminated string passed in DX. It then loads DX with the offset 01B9h and invokes INT 21h function 09h again to print a secondary string (such as a newline or standard message trailer) before returning.

params.name: str
params.desc: Offset address in DS of the '$'-terminated string to print

instrs.comment: Print the primary string pointed to by DX using DOS INT 21h, AH=09h
Print the secondary suffix string located at DS:[01B9h]
